name: AmitabhC - Production Grade
features: 6 Built-in Namespaces (SHAHENSHAH, COOLIE, KHAZANA, NASEEB, ZANJEER, DEEWAR)
All error messages are Amitabh Bachchan dialogues

builtInNamespaces.COOLIE: Math functions (abs, sqrt, pow, sin, cos, etc.)
builtInNamespaces.KHAZANA: Array functions (push, pop, sort, slice, etc.)

changes: FIX: Unary - and ! now bind only to their immediate operand (BOLO -5 + 3 prints -2, not -8)
FIX: Loops and AGNEEPATH can now be nested in any combination (shared KHATAM terminator counted correctly)
FIX: Identifiers starting with a keyword (AGARBATTI, DONATION) no longer misparsed
FIX: Unknown statements now raise an error instead of being silently ignored
FIX: Nested KBC_SAWAAL switches supported; OPTION values evaluated lazily
FIX: Error messages carry a single Line N: prefix; MRITYU catch variable receives a clean message
FIX: DEEWAR/SILSILA outside a loop is an error instead of a silent successful exit
FIX: Code after ACTION is rejected (one program per file); CAMERA must follow LIGHTS
FIX: QUIT_GAME terminates cleanly as success and is not catchable by MRITYU
FIX: Compound /= division-by-zero uses the iconic dialogue message
FIX: DON validates the constant name before storing it
FIX: CLI no longer exits silently when piped stdin ends mid-SUNO; friendly error for non-file paths; errors printed once
FEATURE: BULAAO f(args) implemented as explicit function-call statement
FEATURE: BAAR BAAR accepts any expression as loop count (BAAR BAAR n MEIN i)
FEATURE: SUNO variable "custom prompt" supported
FEATURE: Missing function arguments default to LAAWARIS
FEATURE: AmitabhC keywords can no longer be shadowed as variable/function names
FEATURE: 75-test automated test suite (15 new regression tests)
PWA: Service worker rebuilt — v4.1.0 cache, relative paths (works under /amitabhc/), resilient install, real asset list
PWA: manifest.json icon paths fixed, correct site URL; pro.html now registers the service worker
EXAMPLES: kbc_quiz split into kbc_quiz, kbc_advanced, kbc_interactive (the latter two never ran before)
FEATURE: AGNEEPATH/MRITYU/PRATIGYA (try-catch-finally)
FEATURE: KBC_SAWAAL/OPTION/SAHI_JAWAB/AGLE_SAWAAL (switch-case)
FEATURE: ZANJEER_LOOP/TAB TAK (do-while loop)
FEATURE: DEEWAR_BANAO{} dictionaries with DEEWAR namespace
FEATURE: String interpolation with ${expr}
FEATURE: String escape sequences \n \t \\ \"
FEATURE: BADHAO/GHATAO (increment/decrement)
FEATURE: LAAWARIS null type fully supported
FEATURE: ZANJEER.isDeewar() type check
FEATURE: Built-in namespace calls as statements
FEATURE: 60-test automated test suite
